title: Contour Next One meter uploads duplicate BG readings
symptom: Duplicate glucose readings appear in the Calibration Data Table when using the Contour Next One meter with automatic upload to xDrip+. Duplicates can occur 1 to 5 or 6 times, minutes or hours apart, and must be manually disabled.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A commenter suggests it may be related to Bluetooth glucose meters in general, and another commenter identifies triggering conditions: meter connected, automatic calibration enabled, doing a BG test without calibrating, then opening xDrip after 30 minutes causes the earlier BG value to be randomly applied as calibration.
fix: Workaround: disable automatic calibration, or click on BG in graph and calibrate every BG, or delete BG. The issue was closed as not about double calibration but about duplicate BG readings, and can be reopened if still occurring.
evidence_quote: Workaround seems to be disabling automatic calibration or click on BG in graph and calibrate every BG or delete BG.
